dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency distribution of darker grey pixel clusters across the cranial and mid-dorsal surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the light-grey baseline and localized darker pigmented patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, prominent high-contrast dark circular mark located on the mid-dorsal plane, posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: One distinct dark circular pigmentation mark or lesion on the upper dorsal surface.
